run_imagenet_benchmark: run the ImageNet classification benchmark with a specified root directory and validation split
build_model_bundle: build a ModelBundle combining a pretrained model, preprocessing, and classification head for GPU inference
create_dataloader: create a DataLoader that concurrently decodes image batches and transfers them to the GPU
get_decode_function: get a decode function that loads and resizes image batches from a list of file paths
review_preprocessing_class: review the Preprocessing class that normalizes image batches using dataset mean and standard deviation
